programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. - Dustin Hoffman, Laurence Olivier, Roy Scheider, William Devane, Marthe Keller (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard (War, Historical drama, Action)

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done. - Danny Trejo, Michelle Rodriguez, Sofía Vergara, Amber Heard, Antonio Banderas (Action)

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy. - Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, David Wenham, Dominic West, Rodrigo Santoro (Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, War)

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. - Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman, Holly Hunter, Ed Harris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Cho Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. - Kate Hallett, Herman Tømmeraas, Aya Furukawa, Justin Chatwin, Steven Ogg (Thriller)

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. - Jasmin Savoy Brown, Lili Simmons, James Jagger, Tessa Munro, Dana L. Wilson (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself. - Maika Monroe, Keir Gilchrist, Daniel Zovatto, Jake Weary, Olivia Luccardi (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: Teenagers Jesse and Hector look forward to a carefree summer, but the murder of a neighbor leads to a terrifying encounter with the supernatural. After breaking into the neighbor's apartment, Jesse and Hector find a collection of ritualistic art and other bizarre items. Soon after Jesse takes a journal of occult writings, he finds a strange mark on his arm. His subsequent erratic behavior leads Jesse's friends and family to the realization that he is possessed. - Andrew Jacobs, Jorge Diaz, Gabrielle Walsh, Richard Cabral, Carlos Pratts (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Crimes of the Future
programme.desc: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs. Meanwhile, a mysterious group tries to use Saul's notoriety to shed light on the next phase of human evolution. - Viggo Mortensen, Léa Seydoux, Kristen Stewart, Scott Speedman, Welket Bungué (Horror, Science fiction)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Cho Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. - Mel Gibson, Madeleine Stowe, Greg Kinnear, Sam Elliott, Chris Klein (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin, John Goodman, Victor Garber (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies. - Dan Aykroyd, Jane Curtin, Michelle Burke, Michael McKean, David Spade (Comedy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. - Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein, Jessica Campbell, Mark Harelik (Comedy, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. - Jay Baruchel, Alice Eve, T.J. Miller, Mike Vogel, Nate Torrence (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. - Harrison Ford, Julia Ormond, Greg Kinnear, Nancy Marchand, John Wood (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them. - Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher, Bruno Kirby, Steven Ford (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: What Women Want
programme.desc: Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson) gets a whole new outlook on life when a fluke accident gives him the ability to read women's minds. At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt). - Mel Gibson, Helen Hunt, Marisa Tomei, Mark Feuerstein, Lauren Holly (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. - Russell Crowe, Karen Gillan, Marton Csokas, Thomas M. Wright, Harry Greenwood (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: Comet
programme.desc: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower. - Justin Long, Emmy Rossum, Eric Winter, Kayla Servi, Ben Pace (Romance, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. - Dennis Quaid, Sarah Jessica Parker, Thomas Haden Church, Ellen Page, Ashton Holmes (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. - Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Guest (Comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Tired of always answering to others, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) go into business for themselves. After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Spacey (Comedy)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Wildling
programme.desc: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events. - Liv Tyler, Brad Dourif, Bel Powley, James Le Gros, Mike Faist (Horror, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. - Charles Esten, Oded Fehr, Brec Bassinger, Joel Johnstone, Lauren Call (Drama)

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. - Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey, D.J. Cotrona, Rick Cramer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. - Dylan O'Brien, Jessica Henwick, Dan Ewing, Michael Rooker, Ariana Greenblatt (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: The Enterprise and its crew follow a Borg ship through a time warp to prevent the Borg from taking over the Earth in a past era. Stuck in the past, Geordi La Forge helps a pioneer of space travel in his efforts to create the first warp drive while Capt. Picard and Cmdr. Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. - Aaron Eckhart, Hilary Swank, Delroy Lindo, Stanley Tucci, D.J. Qualls (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. - Jordana Brewster, Clea DuVall, Laura Harris, Josh Hartnett, Shawn Hatosy (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Este Haim, Elizabeth Berkley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. - Shanti Lowry, Sophia Ali, Andrew Howard, Omar Gooding, Dylan Mooney (Thriller)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Colin Farrell (Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Tired of always answering to others, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) go into business for themselves. After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Spacey (Comedy)

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.desc: When Ryan learns that he's been diagnosed with a rare, fatal illness his best friend Seth has other plans for him as he talks him into maxing out his credit cards and doing everything he's ever wanted to do from his Bucket List. - Blake Blossom, Chanel Camryn (Adults only, Erotic)

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. - Matthew Gray Gubler, AnnaLynne McCord, Alisha Boe, Sheila Vand, Sam Eidson (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. - Rainn Wilson, Elliot Page, Liv Tyler, Kevin Bacon, Nathan Fillion (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. - Frankie Faison, Steve O'Connell, Enrico Natale, Ben Marten, Angela Peel (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin. - Katie Featherston, Sprague Grayden, Lauren Bittner, Christopher Nicholas Smith, Chloe Csengery (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Though well-meaning scientists thought they'd destroyed them all, a single gigantic, murderous Judas Breed cockroach, which is capable of taking on the shape of a human, is still on the loose. When the monster follows entomologist Remi Panos and kills her boyfriend, Jason Mundy, Remi becomes the prime suspect. Assigned to the case, detective Klaski grows convinced of her innocence and soon joins forces with her to hunt down the creature. - Alix Koromzay, Bruno Campos, Will Estes, Joseph Hodge, Jon Polito (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Found terrified and alone in rural Louisiana, Nell Sweetzer is now safely in New Orleans. She can't remember the terrible events of the previous months, only that she is the only surviving member of her family. Nell wants to start a new life for herself, but just as she begins the difficult process, the evil force that once possessed her returns -- bringing with it unimaginably horrific plans that mean her last exorcism was just the beginning. - Ashley Bell, Julia Garner, Spencer Treat Clark, Louis Herthum, David Jensen (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
programme.desc: Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions. - Michael Douglas, Val Kilmer, Tom Wilkinson, John Kani, Bernard Hill (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. - Ellen Page, Sam Keeley, Tom Vaughan-Lawlor, Stuart Graham, Peter Campion (Horror, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Spell
programme.desc: While flying to his father's funeral in rural Appalachia, an intense storm causes Marquis to lose control of the plane carrying himself and his family. He soon awakens wounded, alone and trapped in Ms. Eloise's attic. Eloise claims she can nurse him back to health with a hoodoo figure she's made from his blood and skin. Unable to call for help, Marquis desperately tries to break free from her dark magic and save his family from a sinister ritual before the rise of the blood moon. - Omari Hardwick, Loretta Devine, John Beasley, Lorraine Burroughs, Hannah Gonera (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: Twenty years after Maria Rossi (Suzan Crowley) murdered three people, her daughter, Isabella (Fernanda Andrade), seeks the truth about that terrible night. Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. With the help of two young exorcists (Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth), Isabella tries to cure Maria -- and engages four demons in a battle for her mother's soul. - Fernanda Andrade, Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth, Suzan Crowley, Ionut Grama (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft. - Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson, Richard T. Jones (Science fiction, Horror)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. - Clint Eastwood, Hilary Swank, Morgan Freeman, Anthony Mackie, Jay Baruchel (Drama)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. - Elisabeth Shue, Steven R McQueen, Adam Scott, Jerry O'Connell, Jessica Szohr (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Greg Harris, Georgina Cates, Kamber Hejlik (Comedy)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force. - Chris J. Murray, Brit Shaw, Olivia Taylor Dudley, Dan Gill, Ivy George (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands. - Ben Affleck, Aaron Eckhart, Uma Thurman, Paul Giamatti, Colm Feore (Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears. - Tom Cruise, Rosamund Pike, Robert Duvall, Richard Jenkins, Werner Herzog (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) springs into action after the arrest of Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), an Army major accused of treason. Suspecting foul play, Jack embarks on a mission to prove that the head of his old unit is innocent. After crossing paths with the law, Reacher must now go on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers. - Tom Cruise, Cobie Smulders, Aldis Hodge, Danika Yarosh, Patrick Heusinger (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. - Russell Crowe, Karen Gillan, Marton Csokas, Thomas M. Wright, Harry Greenwood (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. - Morgan Freeman, Monica Potter, Michael Wincott, Penelope Ann Miller, Michael Moriarty (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin, John Goodman, Victor Garber (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography)

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. - Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Joker

Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. - Joaquin Phoenix, Robert De Niro, Zazie Beetz, Frances Conroy, Brett Cullen (Crime drama)

programme.title: Non-Typical Nation - Bushveld Untamed Part 3: Gemsbok
programme.desc: Basso Safaris, Limpopo region of South Africa welcomes Non-Typical Nation. Amy is on the hunt for a spot-and-stalk Gemsbok! (Outdoors)

programme.title: Americana Outdoors - Goose Hunting In Texas
programme.desc: S32E1 - This week on Americana Outdoors presented by Garmin, we're in Amarillo, Texas with Cadillac Creek Outfitters for some of the best waterfowl hunting in the nation! (Outdoors)

programme.title: Waterfowl East - Fresh Corn
programme.desc: S3E5 - Waterfowl East gets into a fresh-cut cornfield, with migration in full swing, the geese and ducks can't resist this spot! Plus a few unique birds for the area drop into our spread! (Hunting)

programme.title: 704 Outdoors - Calling Wild Hogs
programme.desc: The team utilizes electronic calling to get things fired up in Texas when the wild hog movement seems to slow down. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Hunt Warz - Mexico Coues Deer: Pro Rodeo Cowboy Matchup 2 of 2
programme.desc: Four professional cowboys venture down to Mexico to take part in one of the most exhilarating hunts of the year - Coues deer in the rut. (Hunting)

programme.title: Sporting Classics With Chris Dorsey - Kicking up Roosters With a Moonwalker
programme.desc: The pheasant fields of South Dakota with General Charles Duke who once walked on the moon. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Viejo Creek Outdoors - The All Star Electric All Stars
programme.desc: S1E5 - Keith goes hunting with his friends and work colleagues from All Star Electric. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures - Chappy in Wyoming - 1 of 3 Mark and Wendy
programme.desc: Experience the wild beauty of Northeastern Wyoming through a trapper's eyes. Bobcats, mountain lions and countless other species roam this rugged country. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Aventures Express.tv Fishing Edition - Mexico Multi-Species Fishing
programme.desc: S1E5 - Mario and Olivier are in Mexico in search of Atlantic sailfish. Along the way, they experience an exceptional multi-species fishing adventure. (Fishing)

programme.title: Deertopia - The Habitat Blueprint
programme.desc: Discover how to plant dormant trees to ensure strong spring growth, guide whitetail deer patterns using strategic food plot transitions and use selective logging to sculpt your woodlot without disrupting mature buck bedding. (Hunting)

programme.title: The Choice - Our Family Deer Camp '26 Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Cianciarulos, along with the crew, all get together for the yearly 'Choice' deer camp for another season back in Illinois! With everyone carrying their bows & mature bucks beginning to move, the crew divides their time between long sits, & more. (Hunting)

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv - TT29 E17 Firearms Pro Tips
programme.desc: A: Metal and Meat Drill. B: Competition Can Fit Anyone/KDG Scopemount. C: Ruger Pistol Pack. D: Projectile Selection. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Whitetail Frenzy - Deer Camp, Good Friends and Late Season Hunts
programme.desc: It's all about friendship and tradition as Kenny heads to deer camp with his closest hunting partners. Watch as bow hunting strategies lead to exciting encounters and successful shots. The episode wraps up with a late-season doe hunt. (Hunting)

programme.title: Claudio Ongaro's Hired to Hunt - Hard Hat Zone
programme.desc: Claudio and five hunters stack up 200 snow geese on a hunt. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Fishing the Wild West - South Sask Walleye
programme.desc: S10E5 - Wes David travels the lakes and rivers of North America on a range of fishing adventures; in the process, he teaches anglers of varying levels of experience how to get the most out of their time on the water. (Fishing)

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony - Texas Bound
programme.desc: Blaine heads to Texas after what might be his worst season ever hunting whitetail deer. Can Texas deliver? (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal TV - Everett Bay Slabs
programme.desc: Lake Vermilion is home to some amazing fishing opportunities with crappies being one of them! (Outdoors)

programme.title: Passion For The Hunt - North Dakota Duck Hunting
programme.desc: Field hunting ducks near Devils Lake, North Dakota; Decoying a variety of puddle ducks in a combined soybean field. (Outdoors)

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler - Close Calls in Alberta Elk Country Part 1
programme.desc: S10E5 - Bulls are bugling as Ryan and Louie DeBrusk return to Alberta elk camp for another shot at success; in studio, co-host Jim Thomson breaks down tactics for hunting thick timber. (Hunting, Outdoors, Reality)

programme.title: The Mellon Patch, It's a Family Thing - Making Cold Process Tallow Soap
programme.desc: S2E4 - It is still mostly winter and Rich and Sandi use the time to make cold process soap from their beef tallow.

programme.title: Red Arrow - The Kansas Day 2 Bandits
programme.desc: Kip and cameraman Lucas Marv team up on a Kansas rut hunt; the timing couldn't have been better, and they find themselves right in the heat of the rut; discovering if the self-proclaimed Day 2 Bandits can get it done in Kansas. (Hunting)

programme.title: 72 Hours to Survive - ATV Survival
programme.desc: S1E6 - Dale meets an ATV rider on an isolated trail, north Central AB, Smokey Lake County; Dale's ATV breaks down, and he must stay out 72 hours with just what the ATV rider had with them, until rescue. (Adventure)

programme.title: Deer & Deer Hunting - Youth Gone Wild
programme.desc: S22E5 - Contributor Josh Honeycutt breaks down the profound impact of hunting mentorship, exploring why it is equally vital to guide the next generation and to have a mentor of your own. (Hunting, Outdoors)

programme.title: Aventures Express.TV - New Zealand Chamois
programme.desc: S4E8 - The team is back in New Zealand for mountain hunts. Their first challenge will be chamois hunting. Quite an adventure awaits them. (Nature, Adventure)

programme.title: Bloodline Adventures TV - Balmy Bucks
programme.desc: S1E5 - Roaming the plains of eastern Alberta in search of monster muley and whitetail deer; will we be lucky enough to find the big guy and do it all in one of the warmest hunting seasons we've had in a long time? (Hunting)

programme.title: Beyond the Blind Hunts - Bullseyes & Bullheads
programme.desc: S1E5 - The crew heads to the Manitoba prairies for gopher shooting action before targeting giant master angler bullheads in this fun-filled summer adventure. (Hunting)

programme.title: The Way It Was Tv - Deer Camp with Hank Parker (New)
programme.desc: On this episode of The Way It Was, legendary professional bass fisherman and lifelong outdoorsman Hank Parker joins the guys for a conversation about all things deer hunting. Hank shares stories, memories, and plenty of laughs. (Hunting)

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv - TT29 E18 Lock, Load, Learn (New)
programme.desc: A: LPVO. B: What Size Gun/KDG Sectional Rail C: Ruger Wrangler Rail D: Bi-Pods. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Mitchell Payment's Moment of Truth TV - Bugles to Honks (New)
programme.desc: S10E5 - Mitchell and his good buddy Gavin are out in pursuit of elk. (Outdoors)

programme.desc: S4E6 - Elephant populations in many protected African reserves are expanding, but what happens to them when a reserve reaches its capacity? Visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola, Dan Cabela investigates a growing problem for the future of elephant conservation. (Docudrama, Science, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Long Range Hunter - Turkey hunt in Quebec and Ontario
programme.desc: Yannick brings you to four different turkey hunts in Quebec and Ontario. (Hunting)

programme.title: Hit Squad Outdoors With Tim Sylvia - Pork Police

programme.title: Reel West Coast - Cariboo Stillwater Solo

programme.title: Trapping Inc. - Otter
